credits.title: The Fox Sisters
credits.overview: Based on historical events, The Fox Sisters tells the story of sisters Leah, Maggie, and Kate Fox, whose experiences helped give rise to modern Spiritualism.

Alongside a friend, the young man becomes involved in a case that dates back to past lives, discovering he is connected to a complex spiritual web.

credits.overview: Gabriela, Roberto's wife, is called to work in the office of Renato, a successful lawyer married to Gioconda. After that, the quartet begins to suffer from lies, exhausting relationships and tragedies.

credits.title: Chico Forever
credits.overview: Twenty years after his death, Chico Xavier, from Minas Gerais, has his life told in the documentary "Chico Para Sempre", directed by Wagner de Assis (Nosso Lar; Kardec) and with the participation of journalist Marcel Souto Maior, author of one of the most successful biographies of the medium.

credits.title: Rogai Por Nós
credits.overview: Rogai Por Nós tells the story of Catholic saints, revered in Brazil, with the presentation of their works, miracles and edifying teachings.

credits.title: A Face Oculta da Medicina
credits.overview: A documentary that tells the story of doctor Paulo Cesar Fructuoso who carried out his work as an oncological surgeon in parallel to the materialization sessions and spiritual surgeries held at the famous Lar de Frei Luiz.

credits.title: Amor Assombrado
credits.overview: A successful writer in a creative crisis lives with her characters and others who do not know what dimension they live in.

credits.title: Kardec
credits.overview: The story of Allan Kardec, from his days as an educator to his contribution to the spiritist codification.
